rounds.prompt: In 117 AD, the Roman Empire's borders were at their largest. How many people live on that same land today?
rounds.source: World Bank population estimates for 2024, split along the empire's 117 AD borders with national census and statistics office figures.

rounds.prompt: How many fire hydrants are there in New York City?
rounds.source: NYC Department of Environmental Protection citywide hydrant records via NYC Open Data

rounds.prompt: How many pairs of shoes are made worldwide each day?
rounds.source: APICCAPS World Footwear Yearbook 2026 (24.6 billion pairs produced in 2025)
